cohort_selection: Uniform12 from original ordered discovery384+selection192, NumPy default_rng2021 choice without replacement. One existing R6-predicted candidate per question; no correctness, margin, R15/R16 outcome or response feature used.

intervention.real: Replace exactly final current-answer suffix; preserve question,25 demonstrations and delimiters.
intervention.claim: Fixed actual input intervention, not known pure nuisance; one wording only. No altered-prompt accuracy is evaluated.

measurement.original: gC=.5*(zC4-zC1), computed FP32; original real states cached.
measurement.shared_metric: All primary vectors use the same original pQ4 full-vocabulary FP64 Fisher metric. R2=cosine^2 is fraction captured by best signed scalar projection, not a deployed coefficient.
measurement.controls: One seed2021 full-vocabulary permutation for e or vN, then re-center in pQ4. Also reference-only alignment under original pN4 and static e/gQ alignment as diagnostics.
measurement.extra: Identity response error ||vQ-vN||²/(||vQ||²+||vN||²); signed least-squares response slope, diagnostic only.
measurement.zero_rule: Norm<=64eps64*maxabs(centeredvector)^2 means undefined direction; save bool mask with zero placeholder. Do not interpret placeholder as observed cosine0.
measurement.prefix: All four contexts independently encode original full continuation. Same literal consumed prefix; any unsupported alignment fails full probe rather than filtering.

analysis.units: 12 questions equally weighted after within-question position average. Report per-position records and coverage. No token independence or correctness metric.
analysis.uncertainty: 10000 whole-question bootstrap draws seed2021; descriptive95%intervals. Exact4096 paired sign flips for R2 advantage over fixed shuffle, exploratory symmetry test.
analysis.operational_screen: High equal-question mean prefix projection only if lower95%R2>.5 AND reference vs shuffle p<.05. Conditional on that, low equal-question mean prefix transfer projection supported for this cue if upper95%transferR2<.5. High mean prefix positive transfer only if lower95%transferR2>.5 and lower95%signedcos>0. Otherwise inconclusive.
analysis.coverage: Any undefined primary/shuffle position blocks operational inferential screen; all raw positions/questions still reported.
analysis.threshold: R2=.5 is a fixed threshold on equal-question means of per-prefix projection fractions, NOT pooled response energy; diagnostic only, never a decoding gate or tuned parameter.
analysis.stop: No new decoder, fitted threshold, alternate cue, sample expansion, heldout, external task or automatic model experiment. Findings inform theoretical next-step review only.

budget.scope: One post-evaluation explanatory observation, actual load/worker/failure time all charged; six old ledgers preserved. Same GPU mutex and CPU nice+15, no other processes altered, no automatic retry.

limitations: Does not establish a universal transport theorem or a new successful method. A cue direction can be unrelated to the natural reference loop increment; that would make this probe inconclusive about broader calibration failures.
pre_feature_interpretation_clarification: No R17 worker or features exist. Equal-prefix then equal-question average is not total response-energy capture. Clarify exported names and interpretation; math/cohort/threshold/shuffle/budget unchanged. Only primary/shuffle undefined positions block screen; native/static auxiliary coverage separate.
